notes: Design approvals from the narrative Art Commission minutes of 1932-1948, found by searching for plans of a named building with an architect within the same passage. 11 curated onto pages: the 1933-bond schools (Glen Park, Marina, Lawton, Visitacion Valley, Patrick Henry, Francis Scott Key, Sunshine), George Washington High's gymnasium, Laguna Honda's 1938 wards, Fire House No. 27 and the North Point plant.

coverage.remaining: Murals and other works of art approved for city buildings (the 1934 PWAP murals at Coit Tower and the schools) not curated; the Matt I. Sullivan School (Applegarth, 1932), the 1932 and 1934 hospital psychopathic and cancer buildings at San Francisco Hospital (Coffey, Rist) and the Outer Mission Junior High (Day and Roller, disapproved 1939) not placed.
coverage.note: Passages found with an ad hoc search; the curated list is /mnt/project-files/sf-art-commission/F4.py.
